PLAINTIFF/ CROSS DEFENDANT KATARINA MARTUCCI IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT/ CROSS COMPLAINANT IS PRESENT. NO PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE ON CROSSCLAIM. PLAINTIFFS/ CROSS DEFENDANTS WAIVES SERVICE. SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-30-2022 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF YANG, SOFIE MARTUCCI, KATARINA RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT NADERI, FRED A.K.A FARAMARZ NADERI $2,140.00 PRINCIPAL, $170.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,310.00, BALANCE OF SECURITY DEPOSIT. THE BATHROOM COUNTER WAS INSTALLED IN 2016. THERE HAVE BEEN A TOTAL OF THREE TENANCIES. ANY STAINING DURING THIS PERIOD OF TIME IS NORMAL WEAR AND TEAR. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
NOTICE OF ENTRY OF JUDGMENT
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-30-2022 - JUDGMENT.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON DEFENDANT'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT CROSS COMPLAINANT NADERI, FRED A.K.A FARAMARZ NADERI IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY CROSS DEFENDANT YANG, SOFIE MARTUCCI, KATARINA INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE PLAINTIFF WERE RESPONSIBLE FOR MISSING FRIDGE SHELF. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
